actual_manual_comparison: Actually compared the original and complete unchanged raw output, paired sheet and white/cyan composites. Swept-back silver-gray hair, gray eyebrows, rounded clear thin dark/metal spectacles and gray moustache remain, with clean chin and serious closed mouth. Dark navy high civilian Chinese tunic, pale collar edging and center fastening retained, without cap or full beard. Compact round mascot head and short broad neck fit the widened original collar without clipping, long pillar neck or white belly at neckline. The dark frame, shaded internal backing and aged lower-right paper are retained; exterior transparency is intentional. Whole-image alpha extrema are [0, 255]. Finite interior sampling is numerical support only, not a claim of globally255 interiors. Composites show no material internal holes. Source remains Chinese CCP related archive-only, prohibited from final mod payload; its art gap is not a release blocker. Art approval only; native derivatives and live-game acceptance are separate.

finite_alpha_support.boundary: Finite numeric support only; actual full image/source/white/cyan comparison supplies visual approval. Exterior alpha zero is expected. No global threshold acceptance.
